answer: Persistent attention audit trail. Each identity must periodically answer open-ended, context-dependent micro-tasks whose answers only accrue value if returned to over days, logged as a ridge of timestamps. Answers must reference prior work in a way that compounds, and a basalt ledger pins each submission to a fixed cost in compute-waiting. An attacker running many identities must staff each with sustained human-like attention, and any jetty of precomputed answers collapses under staleness checks. Per-identity cost: continuous daily attention plus forfeited deposits when continuity breaks.
